_comment: api block = the Blizzard Game Data feed. Create YOUR OWN client at develop.battle.net/access/clients (install.bat walks you through it) — never ship or reuse someone else's credentials; abuse lands on their account. realms maps our scope name to the connected-realm ID (0 = resolve via the realm index). Machine-local — never commit real secrets.
_comment_backend: backend block = the crowdsourced GoblinMind feed (WoWVault/Proposals/api-feed-proposal.md). url points at a goblin_server.py instance; the bearer token auto-registers into api_state.json on first use. scopes = your GM.Scope() names. upload=false makes a read-only client. Machine-local — never shipped. key = the shared secret when the host gates registration via goblin_server.json.
